CA.rationale: No attention/processing-attention relation to content is asserted.

COD.rationale: Content (identified coordinates/red), an explicit presentation/organization pattern, and a separately reported origin/status are present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No text links an attention/allocation or processing condition to the identified content's presentation or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify referents and attributes (red/blue) with literal coordinate values.

D.rationale: An origin/status field is reported separately from the content coordinates for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report describes how contents are laid out and provides coordinate sets showing organized presentation patterns.
